'''Malachor III''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Malachor system/Legends|Malachor system]].

==History==
Malachor III was a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] long before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and even before the [[Mandalorian Wars]]; it was the burial ground of [[Terrak Morrhage]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the resurgent Sith Empire, dead centuries before the Cold War. His spirit remained dormant until it was awakened by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] expedition composed of [[Parkanas Tark]], [[Yuon Par]], [[Duras Fain]], [[Sidonie Garen]], [[Eriz Vossan]] and [[Cin Tykan]]. Morrhage's spirit played with the emotions of the young Jedi and drove them insane. Having escaped the planet, the Jedi reported their discovery to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], which declared the planet as "barren."

[[Darth Thanaton]], after he had supposedly killed [[Darth Zash]]'s [[Darth Nox|apprentice]], left for Malachor III, where he had business to attend to.
